title: Visual polish: calmer surfaces and compact learning controls
summary: Refine the existing Academy identity using actual small-screen renders: compact teacher prompts, browse-first explorer, clearer profile and responsive lesson controls.

changes.detail: Remove default card elevation, distinguish tonal/outline/text buttons, preserve loading contrast and add keyboard focus borders.
Compact narrow teacher prompts and home hero; wrap lesson steps for narrow screens or enlarged text; bound bottom-tab labels.
Make explorer goal form expandable, keep filters in an RTL-aware horizontal row, flatten nested course rows and provide clear-filter recovery.
Give profile identity/goal clearer hierarchy and use meaningful navigation icons.
Add native safe-area containment to fullscreen coding editor; runtime documentation remains available in an accessible disclosure.

validation.name: Visual audit
validation.detail: Reviewed existing English 320px explorer and lesson, Arabic 320px teacher and English profile screenshots; retained the earlier 47-route/layout inventory and design identity.

validation.name: Validation
validation.detail: Fresh static checks, regression suite, stateful visual checks and builds pending. Physical-device keyboards and animation performance require device testing.
